d: A square in the town of Putivl. Left of the Kremlin. On the right a church. Next to a bell tower. - In the background a walkable defensive wall. In it a large wooden gate, which stands open. The warriors are ready for marching out. The people greet them. As the curtain rises Prince Igor, accompanied by princes and Bojaren, steps solemnly out of the church.
In the courtyard of the house of Vladimir Galitzky.
A room in the house of Jaroslavna. Jaroslavna alone
In front of a camp of polovets. In the background a wooden watchtower. On the right a camp with a tent Konchakovnas

In the camp of the Polovetsks. Left behind Verhauen Prince Igor, Vladimir and the captured Russians. - The Chan Gsak leads a looting of newly captured Russians. - They are partly in front of wagons on which the captured women and the loot are loaded. The whole camp is in highest arousal.
Place in the town of Putivl as in the 1st picture. Part of the wooden wall is burned. Jaroslawna stands on the Wehrgang and looks longingly into the distance
